dish_bunlab_burger.name: Bunlab Double Beef Burger & Crispy Fries
dish_bunlab_burger.description: Fresh grilled double beef patty on toasted sesame bun with melted cheese, lettuce, and crispy french fries.

dish_bunlab_shawarma.name: Jumbo Chicken Shawarma Roll
dish_bunlab_shawarma.description: Warm grilled pita wrap loaded with shredded chicken, creamy garlic mayo, sausage, and crunchy cabbage.

dish_bunlab_meatpie.name: Flaky Beef Meat Pie & Glazed Doughnut
dish_bunlab_meatpie.description: Freshly baked buttery pastry filled with minced beef and potato chunks, with a sweet glazed doughnut.

dish_bunlab_sausageroll.name: Golden Sausage Roll & Chilled Drink Combo
dish_bunlab_sausageroll.description: Crisp pastry roll with seasoned sausage filling served with chilled soda.

dish_bunlab_pizza.name: Cheesy Pepperoni Pizza Slice
dish_bunlab_pizza.description: Large oven-baked pizza slice loaded with mozzarella cheese and spicy pepperoni slices.

dish_mg_jollof_chicken.name: Multi-grace Smoky Party Jollof & Fried Chicken
dish_mg_jollof_chicken.description: Authentic firewood-infused jollof rice served with seasoned fried chicken and sweet fried plantain.

dish_mg_fried_rice_turkey.name: Special Fried Rice with Crispy Turkey & Plantain
dish_mg_fried_rice_turkey.description: Wok-tossed seasoned fried rice with veggies, sweet corn, and golden fried turkey cut.

dish_mg_beans_dodo.name: Ewa Aganyin with Golden Dodo & Boiled Egg
dish_mg_beans_dodo.description: Mashed honey beans topped with fiery caramelized spicy palm oil sauce, fried plantains, and a boiled egg.

dish_mg_spag_sausage.name: Stir-Fried Spaghetti with Sausage & Egg
dish_mg_spag_sausage.description: Rich tomato stir-fried spaghetti with sliced sausages, sweet bell peppers, and boiled egg.

dish_mg_ayamase.name: Spicy White Rice with Designer Ayamase Sauce
dish_mg_ayamase.description: Steamed white rice paired with green pepper Designer ofada/ayamase sauce, boiled egg, and beef cuts.

dish_k3_amala_abula.name: Kitchen3 Hot Amala with Abula & Goat Meat
dish_k3_amala_abula.description: Smooth hot yam flour swallow (Amala) drenched in abula (Gbegiri & Ewedu) with tender goat meat.

dish_k3_pounded_yam.name: Pounded Yam with Rich Egusi & Assorted Meat
dish_k3_pounded_yam.description: Fluffy pounded yam paired with thick spinach melon seed soup (Egusi) and assorted offal & beef cuts.

dish_k3_semo_eforiro.name: Steamed Semo with Fresh Efo Riro & Catfish
dish_k3_semo_eforiro.description: Smooth semolina swallow paired with savory vegetable stew packed with dried crayfish, ponmo, and catfish.

dish_k3_catfish_peppersoup.name: Fresh Catfish Pepper Soup with Boiled Yam
dish_k3_catfish_peppersoup.description: Hot aromatic herbal broth loaded with fresh point-and-kill catfish cut and boiled yam cubes.

dish_mf_parfait.name: Signature Greek Yogurt Fruit Parfait with Granola
dish_mf_parfait.description: Layered thick greek yogurt with diced strawberries, kiwi, apples, honey drizzle, and crunchy almond granola.

dish_mf_zobo.name: Organic Spiced Zobo with Ginger & Pineapple (50cl)
dish_mf_zobo.description: Naturally brewed chilled hibiscus tea steeped with fresh ginger root, pineapple, cloves, and mint.

dish_mf_watermelon_juice.name: Fresh Cold-Pressed Watermelon-Pineapple Juice (50cl)
dish_mf_watermelon_juice.description: 100% pure fresh cold-pressed watermelon and ripe pineapple juice with zero added sugar.

dish_mf_chapman.name: Signature Nigerian Iced Chapman
dish_mf_chapman.description: Refreshing fruit soda blend infused with angostura bitters, grenadine, lemon slices, and cucumber ribbon.

dish_mf_fruit_bowl.name: Jumbo Mixed Fresh Fruit Bowl
dish_mf_fruit_bowl.description: Chilled freshly sliced watermelon, sweet pawpaw, crisp gala apples, and seedless grapes.

dish_k5_rice_stew.name: Mummy & Daddy Homestyle Rice & Pepper Chicken Stew
dish_k5_rice_stew.description: Fluffy white rice served with rich seasoned tomato-pepper stew, fried chicken, and dodo.

dish_k5_yam_egg.name: Crispy Golden Fried Yam with Spicy Egg Sauce
dish_k5_yam_egg.description: Golden fried yam fingers with hot scrambled pepper egg sauce and fried plantains.

dish_k5_beef_suya.name: Peppered Beef Suya & Roasted Onion Pack
dish_k5_beef_suya.description: Thinly sliced boneless beef skewers roasted over open coals and dusted with authentic yaji spice and sliced onions.

dish_k5_bbq_wings.name: Flame-Grilled BBQ Chicken Wings (6 pcs)
dish_k5_bbq_wings.description: Six juicy grilled chicken wings glazed in sticky sweet-and-spicy barbecue sauce.

dish_k5_beans_dodo.name: Sweet Fried Plantain (Dodo) & Honey Beans Bowl
dish_k5_beans_dodo.description: Slow-simmered sweet honey beans stew paired with hot golden fried plantain chunks.
